text_blocks.snippet: High blood pressure, also known as hypertension, is impacted by a combination of lifestyle choices, genetics, and underlying health conditions. Key factors include diet (excessive salt intake, lack of potassium), physical inactivity, obesity, alcohol consumption, smoking, stress, and family history. Certain medical conditions like kidney disease and diabetes can also contribute to elevated blood pressure.
